---
name: "Feature request / 功能建议"
about: "Suggest a scoped, testable improvement with a clear use case."
title: "[Feature] "
---

## Problem to solve / 问题背景

What workflow is difficult today, and why?

## Fictional example / 虚构示例

Provide a synthetic or safely redacted old/new rule example when possible.

## Desired behavior / 期望结果

What output or behavior would help? How would you verify it?

## Current workaround / 当前替代方式

How do you handle this today?

## Scope and risks / 边界与风险

- Does this need unsupported PDF/DOCX/OCR, external fetching, or personal context?
- Could it require new permissions or external actions?
- What should happen when the evidence is ambiguous?

RequirementDelta is not an official eligibility checker or legal-compliance system. Do not include protected source documents or report vulnerabilities publicly. Use [private security reporting](https://github.com/Jozhio/RequirementDelta/security/advisories).
